uncertain: Sources beyond akurasu and the official Unicorn English site are English fan wikis (mechabay.com, which mirrors Gundam Wiki content) because gundam.fandom.com returned 403/402 to my tools. Terms sourced only there: Augusta Laboratory, Globe, Cheyenne Base, Torrington Base, Garuda, Gryps 2, Kshatriya Besserung/Repaired, Psycho-Shard, Psycho Jammer, General Revil, La+ System, UC Project.

Conflicts with brief proposals (corrected): Cyam Vist -> Syam Vist (official site + akurasu Master list); Darryl McGuinness -> Daryl McGuinness; Galuda -> Garuda; Megalanica -> Magallanica (official site spelling); Bessellung -> Besserung; Echoes -> ECOAS; UC Plan -> UC Project; Pull Twelve -> Ple Twelve; Tri-Star -> Tri-Stars; Hamma-Hamma -> Hamma Hamma (akurasu ZZ page).

PRECEDENCE CONFLICT: NAME_RESEARCH.md ranks Jigoku shipped library English (4) above official English (5). I chose the official English where the two differ and the official source is verifiable: 移民問題評議会 'Settlement Issues Council' (Jigoku: 'Council on Emigration Issues'), アナハイム...専門学校 'Anaheim Electronics Industrial College' (Jigoku: 'Technical College'), エコーズ 'ECOAS' (Jigoku: 'Echoes'/'Ecoes'), メガラニカ 'Magallanica'. If the orchestrator prefers Jigoku consistency, these four are the ones to flip.

Anaheim Electronics school: the official site itself uses 'Industrial College' (page 01: Banagher, Takuya, Micott) and 'Technical School' (Cardeas page 04); Wikipedia uses 'Anaheim Industry Technical School'. No single official form.

Ple Twelve vs Puru 12: akurasu's Unicorn page writes 'Puru 12' for Marida, but its Master Characters List uses 'Ple' (Elpeo Ple, Ple Two). I followed the Ple family. Jigoku shipped also says 'Ple Twelve'. If akurasu 'Puru' wins, Ple and Ple Two must change too (gundam_5/other briefs may hold Ple Two).
Nigel Garrett: akurasu Unicorn page says 'Garret' (one t); Z3.2 pilot database and Master list say 'Garrett'; Z3.2 database used.
Daryl McGuinness: Master list writes 'Mcguinness', the Unicorn page and Wikipedia 'McGuinness'; used 'McGuinness'.

Rank translations: the Japanese 大尉/中尉/大佐/中佐/少佐/少尉 (captain/first lieutenant/colonel/lieutenant colonel/major/ensign in Jigoku wording) differ from the official site's Navy-style ranks (Lieutenant, Commander, Captain). Profiles follow the Japanese DSCR wording; the official rank is given in brackets in the position field.
Alec (pilot 199) and Besson (pilot 200): gender left unknown, no source found states it and the DSCR has no pronoun.
Hamma Hamma: brief said Hamma-Hamma; akurasu ZZ page has 'Hamma Hamma'; mechabay/Gundam Wiki use a hyphen.
Psycho Jammer is unhyphenated (mechabay) while Psycho-Shard is hyphenated (mechabay, Neo Zeong page); the official spelling of either was not checked against a kit box or the official site.

ジオン is short for many things (name of Zeon, Zeon military, Zeon remnant forces); 'Zeon' works for all uses I saw, but ジオン公国 (Principality of Zeon) and ネオ・ジオン (Neo Zeon) are gundam_5's names; my First/Second Neo Zeon War spellings assume Neo Zeon = 'Neo Zeon'.
